# Stage 4 results (synthetic oracles; generated by analysis/make_figures.py)

## E2/E3 — strong scaling and H-coop

Time-to-target is censored at the horizon H = 150,000 s (virtual). RMST = restricted mean of min(T, H). Calls are counted up to reaching the target, or all calls by H if censored. 95% bootstrap CIs.
